scope: Read-only implementation contract advice for future Stage039/040; not implementation acceptance or financial replay
findings: fixed_size must remain 0, risk_budget final selected volume may only be capped downward to one.
The complete native risk_amount is a frozen per-intent authorization ceiling; do not substitute raw risk_ratio times total equity.
Fill risk uses actual open and unique unsynced matching layer effective stop; no signal-price distance and no same-day future close/ATR.
Reject stale/missing/invalid intent budget, stopped-through open, nonpositive capital; cancel target/order and only unmatched unfilled state.
Native minimum monetary risk budget and minimum per-contract tick risk differ from forbidden quantity floor zero-to-one.
Rollover OPEN also requires an authentic budget.

recommendations.native_budget: min(max(limited_balance * selected_risk_ratio, min_risk_per_trade), max_risk_per_trade) * effective_multiplier * overheat_scale * directional_30d_multiplier
recommendations.budget_ceiling: Original final signal risk_amount bound to unique intent is mandatory. If also reapplying current capital, use min(original authorized final amount, pure causal open-account recomputation using frozen factors); do not silently expand a stale intent.
recommendations.state_identity: contract + direction + original signal timestamp + unique unsynced one-lot layer identity; reissued order time is separate.
recommendations.cost_scope: Keep native stop-distance budget definition explicit. Already realized costs reduce open equity; fees/slippage remain separately reported and cannot justify guaranteed-loss claims.

tests: signal passes but opening gap over budget rejects without pos mutation; same-day close change cannot alter decision
exact budget equality allows; epsilon-over rejects; long and short mirrors
risk_budget zero must stay zero through all floors/recovery wrappers
missing/nonfinite budget, price, tick, size, stop or opening equity fails closed
open already on wrong side of stop rejects, not absolute-distance accept
stale and reissued intent use original identity/budget and cancel is idempotent
close pending does not release actual margin; actual close fill may release it
two opens sequentially consume actual opening margin/cost; no same-day future-close leak
rollover opens cannot bypass native risk budget or materialize >1 product gross
rejected new intent removes only unsynced state and targeted pending diagnostic links; actual positions survive
limitations: This preimplementation note does not certify future code.
Stop-distance risk is a planning scenario, not a guarantee of actual maximum loss under gap, limit moves, missing quotes or next-open exits.
Does not change risk clusters, thresholds, product inclusion or intraday-disabled policy.
